comment: Single source of truth for CoreLink's GitHub identity, read by scripts/server_repository.py. An id of 0 means 'not read back yet': the loader refuses it, so fill each id only from a readback of the live object (GET repositories/<id> or orgs/<owner>), never from memory. historical_server_owners and retired_repository_ids exist only to verify artifacts and packets made before the 2026-10 recreate; they never authorize a live run.
